rule_text: Company-level exclusion (see companies.csv: template/demo form, wrong city, or capture failure)
BookingKoala row not verified: Booking Summary did not show the selected options (usually a service/frequency pair the form does not offer)
No usable price (blank or $0 displayed) - kept as missing, never treated as $0
Out of scope service (Airbnb/short-term rental, post-construction, commercial, carpet, hourly, single-room, non-cleaning)
Service prices identical to another service for every combination - likely the service switch did not register; needs live check
Launch27 row expanded a non-size counter (kitchen, laundry, stories...) above its minimum, or a per-sq-ft counter the harvester truncated
Placeholder/invalid option value (e.g. "Bedrooms", "None", malformed sq ft label)
Duplicate of another row with identical price and scope (non-pricing field differs only) - collapsed in analytical table
Duplicate service entry ("-Copy") on the form
Included in analytical table after de-duplication
